_thinking: Every class is Thinking:false on purpose, not by omission. On a 4B,
thinking cost 60-80s and produced the same answer as the 2.2s call, or
an empty one. All eight are still declared so turning one on is a
one-word edit rather than a rediscovery.
Reflection is the agent that returns nothing either way; it is off.
_embedding: The base file asks for the OpenAI embeddings endpoint, which this tier
has no key for and would not want anyway: minimal is the offline tier.
Left alone it spent a doomed HTTP round-trip and a warning on every
single turn before skipping passages regardless. "none" takes the same
branch in every caller and says so on purpose -- "onnx" is the setting
to restore once models/embedding/ actually has weights in it.
